brief: We have 400 paying customers at £20 per customer per month. We want monthly recurring revenue to rise by at least 15% within three months. We could raise the price to £22, keep the price and improve onboarding, or offer annual contracts. Customer interviews suggest that raising the price could cause 10–20% churn, but that evidence is weak. We have £1,000 available for one-off research. Help us model the trade-offs and avoid counting the same revenue twice.
